items.docs: Use this endpoint to create a new individual client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all personal and bank account details from those providers.
Use this endpoint to create a new business client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all business and bank account details from those providers.

Use this endpoint to create a new receive-only client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all personal and bank account details from those providers. Otherwise, must provide either FirstName/LastName or BusinessName

Use this endpoint to create a new standard client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all personal and bank account details from those providers. Otherwise, must provide either FirstName/LastName or BusinessName

params.name: ClientType
params.description: Type of account to be filtered. Use either 'individual', 'business' or 'receive-only'

params.name: AccountStatus
params.description: Filter by account status. Use true for active accounts and false for inactive.

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: Filter by the Client account ID

params.name: Limit
params.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

params.name: Offset
params.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

params.name: SearchText
params.description: A text string to search for in the email addresses, names and business number.

items.docs:
This endpoint returns a list of the available client accounts and some of its details.

It is also possible to filter the list of client accounts by ClientAccountID, its status (active or inactive), and client type (business, individual, receive-only).

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: Client account ID of customer who's balance you want to retrieve

params.name: Currency
params.description: 3 character currency code for the currency to fetch transactions for. If this is not specified it will be defaulted to the account's local currency (generally CAD).

This endpoint is used to delete a note record from you client account.

params.description: The ID for a specific getting a specific note

items.docs: This endpoint is used to look up all the notes associated with the given client account.
This endpoint will transfer money directly from the debitor client account to the recipient client account. Both client accounts must be active.

This endpoint will fund the Debitor client account using their default bank account, and then trigger an account transfer to the recipient client account once the funds have been cleared. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

This endpoint will transfer money from the debitor client account to the recipient client account, and then immediately withdraw the money from the recipient client account into their default bank account. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

This endpoint will fund the debitor client account using their default bank account, and then transfer the money to the recipient client account once the funds have been cleared. Once the funds are transferred, a withdraw transaction will be triggered to send the funds to the recipient client account's default bank account. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

params.name: StartDateTime
params.description: Return transactions that occurred on or after this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: EndDateTime
params.description: Return transactions that occurred on or before this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: Filter transactions by Client account ID

params.name: Currency
params.description: 3 character currency code for the currency to fetch transactions for. If this is not specified it will be defaulted to the account's local currency (generally CAD).

params.name: TransactionType
params.description: Specifies the type of transaction to return. Accepted values are: 'EFT Funding', 'EFT Withdrawal', 'Interac Money Request', 'Interac Bulk Payout', 'Credit Card', 'Fee', 'Reversal'.

params.name: TransactionID
params.description: Searches for a transaction with the specified transaction ID, including any related child transactions which may exist.

params.name: ClientReferenceNumber
params.description: Searches for transactions with the specified client reference number.

params.name: ScheduledTransactionID
params.description: Id of the schedule transaction to search

params.name: WalletID
params.description: Id of the wallet that the transactions should belong to

params.name: IsFlagged
params.description: Filter the list of transactions to only include transactions that have a flag status and have not been confirmed by the client.

params.name: IsRefunded
params.description: Filter the list of transactions to only include transactions that have been refunded.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list all of the transactions which affect the account balance. This endpoint only returns basic information on the transactions. More detailed information on individual transactions is available from other API endpoints.
This endpoint is used to schedule a fund-transfer between two client accounts.
This endpoint is used to schedule a transfer-withdraw between two client accounts.
This endpoint is used to schedule a fund-transfer-withdraw between two client accounts.

This endpoint is used to cancel a scheduled client account transfer and all remaining payments belonging to that scheduled transfer. Only scheduled transfers with the status in progress can be cancelled.

params.name: ScheduledTransferID
params.description: ID of the schedule transfer (if this value is present, we list the details of the scheduled tranfser)

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: The Client Account ID that the scheduled transactions belong to

params.name: StartDate
params.description: Return Client account transfers scheduled for or after this date/time. Can be specified in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: EndDate
params.description: Return Client account transfers scheduled for or before this date/time. Can be specified in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to look up either the list of all scheduled client account transfers, or to list the details of a single scheduled client account transfer. 

 If the value ScheduledTransferID is present, we only list the details of that scheduled client account transfer.
This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of wallets belong to a client account.
This endpoint allows you to create a new wallet for your client account.
This endpoint allows you to transfer funds between two wallets. Both wallet IDs must belong to the provided client account.
This endpoint allows you to delete a wallet if the wallet balance is 0.
This endpoint allows you to edit a wallet for your client account.
This endpoint allows you to deactivate a wallet for your client account.
This endpoint allows you to activate a wallet for your client account.

info.name: Client Account Auto Balance Transfer Endpoints

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: The Client Account ID to which the wallet belongs

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to retrieve the information of your auto balance transfer. 

 This option requires special permissions.

This endpoint allows you to set up an auto-balance transfer from your VoPay account to your default operational bank account. The frequency available to set the auto-transfer can be daily, weekly, bi-weekly or monthly. 

This option requires special permission.

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: The Client Account ID to which the wallet belongs

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to retrieve a list of all your auto balance transfers. 

 This option requires special permissions.

This endpoint allows you to cancel an auto balance transfer. 

 This option requires special permissions.

params.name: ClientAccountID
params.description: The Client Account ID to which the wallet belongs

params.name: TransactionID
params.description: Transaction ID of the auto-balance transfer transaction

items.docs:
This endpoint returns the list of transactions associated with an auto balance transfer. 

The sum of all debits/credits should match the amount on the auto-balance transfer.
